name: id
description: Unique disbursement identifier (hashed). One row per payout attempt to the beneficiary.

name: user_id
description: Sender user identifier (hashed). Same user as in the linked payment and receipt.

name: type
description: Payout method at destination: BANK, CASH, WALLET or CASH DELIVERY.

name: status
description: Normalized payout status. Mixed vocabularies and casing coexist (e.g. PAID/COMPLETED/Success, FAILED/Failed) because each provider reports differently; needs mapping in staging.

name: raw_status
description: Status as originally reported by the provider/integration, before normalization into status.

name: provider_status
description: Free-form status or code returned by the payout provider (e.g. PAYMENT_HAS_BEEN_COMPLETED, HOLD:11102002, 503). Null for ~78% of rows.

name: amount
description: Amount to be paid to the beneficiary, expressed in destination_currency (local currency, not USD).

name: disbursement_provider
description: Payout provider/integration that processed the attempt (PROVIDER 1..12).

name: payer_destination_name
description: Paying institution or network at destination (bank, cash-out chain or wallet), anonymized as DESTINATION_n. Several payers operate under each provider.

name: destination_country
description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (some rows contain "COSTA RICA" instead of CR, or are null).

name: destination_currency
description: Currency of amount, ISO 4217 (MXN, GTQ, HNL, COP, USD, DOP, PEN, BRL, CRC).

name: created_at
description: Timestamp when the disbursement attempt was created (UTC).

name: updated_at
description: Timestamp of the last status update (UTC). Null for some cancelled/rejected/failed rows.
